senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; נָתַן)giving, gift.—מַתּן תורה giving of the Law, revelation at Mount Sinai.
units: Gen. R. s. 34; a. fr.—מ׳ שכר reward.
Ab. II, 16; a. fr.—מ׳ דמים sprinkling or smearing the blood (on the altar &c.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 8:10">Zeb. VIII, 10</cite> <he>מַתַּן ארבע במ׳ ארבע</he> blood requiring four applications mixed with &c.; R. Hash. l. c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 10:14:3">Y. Erub. X, end, 26ᵈ</cite>; Bab.

<cite ref="Eruvin 100a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ ארבע במ׳ אחת</he> (Zeb. l. c. <he>במתנה</he>) blood requiring four applications mixed with blood requiring one application; a. fr.—<he>מַשָּׂא ומַ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02796"><he>מַשָּׂא</he></cite>.
